title: Fix fragment() queries on different paths sharing a cache entry
defect: None. Minimal correct fix (path added to the query hash) plus a focused regression test.
probe:
from tinydb import Query
q1 = Query().a.fragment({'x': 1}); q2 = Query().b.fragment({'x': 1})
DEFECT_PRESENT = (q1 == q2)

title: Make update_multiple() work with generators
defect: The added `break` stops after the first matching update, so a document matched by two (fields, cond) pairs now only receives the first update. Existing tests and the hidden tests only use disjoint conditions, so CI stays green.
probe:
from tinydb import TinyDB, where
from tinydb.storages import MemoryStorage
db = TinyDB(storage=MemoryStorage)
db.insert({'id': 1})
db.update_multiple([({'x': 1}, where('id') == 1), ({'y': 2}, where('id') == 1)])
DEFECT_PRESENT = 'y' not in db.all()[0]

title: Add TinyDB.rename_table()
defect: rename_table itself is correct, but the shared `_require_table` helper makes drop_table() raise ValueError for missing tables (it was a silent no-op), and the PR edits the existing test_drop_table assertions so CI stays green.
probe:
from tinydb import TinyDB
from tinydb.storages import MemoryStorage
db = TinyDB(storage=MemoryStorage)
try:
    db.drop_table('nope'); DEFECT_PRESENT = False
except ValueError:
    DEFECT_PRESENT = True

title: Add operations.append for list fields
defect: The default list is created once per append() call and shared by every document that lacks the field, so `db.update(append('tags', 'x'))` over N documents gives each of them the SAME list containing 'x' N times. The PR's own tests only touch one document.
probe:
from tinydb import TinyDB
from tinydb.storages import MemoryStorage
from tinydb.operations import append
db = TinyDB(storage=MemoryStorage)
db.insert_multiple([{'n': 1}, {'n': 2}])
db.update(append('tags', 'x'))
DEFECT_PRESENT = db.all()[0]['tags'] != ['x']
